events.title: Discovery of Mobile BC200 Gene in Human Brain Cells

takeaways: BC200 evolved from transposon but retained mobility and functional cellular role (rare)
Expressed mainly in neurons; appears to regulate mRNA-to-protein translation
Also appears at low levels in germ cells (sperm/eggs), suggesting inheritance potential

Published in Science, September 24, 2026

events.title: Rejetto HFS Vulnerability Exploited in the Wild

Attackers can reconstruct the generator's state, forge administrator session cookies, and achieve remote code execution. Horizon3.ai researchers used Anthropic's Mythos AI model to discover the flaw; Rejetto patched in July 2026, but active exploitation from China Telecom IPs began by October 2.
takeaways: CVE-2026-61500: critical vulnerability, CVSS 9.3, affects all versions before 3.2.1
Weak RNG (xorshift128+) outputs mathematically reversible by attackers
Enables session cookie forgery and remote code execution via server_code
Discovered June 2026 using Anthropic's Mythos AI for mathematical analysis
Rejetto released patch version 3.2.1 on July 13, 2026
Active exploitation in wild as of October 2, 2026 from China Telecom IPs
Targeting canaries in Japan and US

Elon Musk plans hourly flights within 2–3 years, expanding Starlink to 100,000 satellites and deploying space-based data centers. SpaceX intends to retire Falcon 9 in 2028, raising concerns among satellite operators and NASA, which has historically dominated the space industry.
takeaways: Starship first orbital test: September 28, 2026 from Starbase
Federal approval for up to 2 additional launches in October
Musk targets hourly Starship flights within 2-3 years
Plans: 100,000-satellite Starlink network and space-based data centers
SpaceX plans Falcon 9 retirement in 2028 despite its widespread use globally
SpaceX conducted 50%+ of 325 global launches in 2025 (over 50 launches)
October 1: three launches in 13 hours (crew to ISS, Google AI data center+129 payloads, spy satellite)
Concerns: Starship acceleration could disrupt launches and harm startups and NASA

events.title: NASA deputy chief warns civilian space race with China closer than U.S. prefers
events.one_liner: NASA deputy administrator Matt Anderson stated on October 5 that the civilian space race with China is "closer than we would like right now." China targets lunar landing by 2030 with Long March 10 heavy-lift rocket and Lanyue lander on track. NASA flew Artemis II around the Moon in April 2026 and converted Artemis III to Earth-orbit testing; Artemis IV aims for lunar landing in 2028, the first since Apollo 17 in 1972.
takeaways: NASA deputy: civilian space race with China closer than desired
China targets lunar landing by 2030
China's Long March 10 rocket, Mengzhou spacecraft, Lanyue lander reportedly on track
NASA Artemis II: four astronauts around Moon, April 2026
Artemis III converted to Earth-orbit test flight (2027)
Artemis IV targets lunar landing in 2028 (first since Apollo 17 in 1972)
NASA leads in all three space sectors; emphasizes scientific exploration over prestige
